name: Sales Order Credit Limit Validation
script:
# Sales Order Credit Limit Validation # Event: Before Submit # Reference DocType: Sales Order customer = doc.customer company = doc.company if customer and company: # ------------------------------------------------ # 1. Fetch Customer Credit Limit # ------------------------------------------------ credit_limit = frappe.db.get_value( "Customer Credit Limit", { "parent": customer, "parenttype": "Customer", "company": company }, "credit_limit" ) # ------------------------------------------------ # 2. Fallback to Customer Group Credit Limit # ------------------------------------------------ if not credit_limit: customer_group = frappe.db.get_value( "Customer", customer, "customer_group" ) if customer_group: credit_limit = frappe.db.get_value( "Customer Credit Limit", { "parent": customer_group, "parenttype": "Customer Group", "company": company }, "credit_limit" ) # ------------------------------------------------ # 3. Fallback to Company Credit Limit # ------------------------------------------------ if not credit_limit: credit_limit = frappe.db.get_value( "Company", company, "credit_limit" ) credit_limit = flt(credit_limit) # Continue only if a positive credit limit exists if credit_limit > 0: # ------------------------------------------------ # 4. Calculate Existing Customer Outstanding # ------------------------------------------------ invoices = frappe.get_all( "Sales Invoice", filters={ "customer": customer, "company": company, "docstatus": 1 }, fields=[ "base_outstanding_amount" ], limit_page_length=0 ) invoice_outstanding = sum( flt(row.base_outstanding_amount) for row in invoices ) # ------------------------------------------------ # 5. Calculate Existing Sales Order Commitments # ------------------------------------------------ sales_orders = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order", filters={ "customer": customer, "company": company, "docstatus": 1, "status": ["not in", ["Closed", "Stopped"]], "per_billed": ["<", 100] }, fields=[ "base_grand_total", "per_billed" ], limit_page_length=0 ) existing_order_commitment = 0 for order in sales_orders: order_total = flt(order.base_grand_total) billed_percentage = flt(order.per_billed) # Only count the unbilled portion remaining_amount = ( order_total * (100 - billed_percentage) / 100 ) existing_order_commitment += remaining_amount # ------------------------------------------------ # 6. Calculate Current Sales Order Amount # ------------------------------------------------ current_order_amount = flt(doc.base_grand_total) # ------------------------------------------------ # 7. Calculate Total Credit Exposure # ------------------------------------------------ total_exposure = ( invoice_outstanding + existing_order_commitment + current_order_amount ) total_exposure = flt(total_exposure, 2) # ------------------------------------------------ # 8. Compare with Credit Limit # ------------------------------------------------ if total_exposure > credit_limit: frappe.throw( """

Customer Credit Limit Exceeded!

Customer: {customer}
Company: {company}

Credit Limit: {limit}
Existing Invoice Outstanding: {invoices}
Existing Sales Order Commitment: {orders}
Current Sales Order Amount: {current}
Total Credit Exposure: {exposure}

The customer has exceeded the approved credit limit. Sales Order submission is not allowed. """.format( customer=frappe.utils.escape_html(customer), company=frappe.utils.escape_html(company), limit=frappe.utils.fmt_money(credit_limit), invoices=frappe.utils.fmt_money(invoice_outstanding), orders=frappe.utils.fmt_money(existing_order_commitment), current=frappe.utils.fmt_money(current_order_amount), exposure=frappe.utils.fmt_money(total_exposure) ), title="Credit Limit Exceeded" )
